qualificationRequirements: Manual-only exploratory test: a human manually updates one listing message cluster at the top of the Shopify App Store listing; app behavior must remain unchanged.

Change one interpretable variable only: revise the top listing copy to make audience + catalog-audit job-to-be-done + read-only safety more explicit; keep pricing, category, support/privacy links, app behavior, and gallery assets constant during the first test window.
If the listing UI requires multiple coordinated top text fields, treat those edits as one message-cluster change and do not change screenshots, setup documentation, or category in the same window.
Record the exact before and after copy, the manual publish timestamp, and the start and end dates of the post-change observation window.

Minimum post-change observation rule: observe for at least 30 days after publish, or longer if traffic remains too sparse to accumulate any interpretable signal. This 30-day minimum is supported by external research synthesis noting Shopify exposes native 30-day analytics views and low-traffic experiments often need longer runtime.
Do not end the test early solely because the first days remain at zero; sparse traffic makes early stopping uninformative.
Interpret results directionally only; do not treat movement as causal proof because evidence quality is low and no impression-normalized baseline is available.

expectedSupportingSignal: After the manual top-copy revision, scan_started_count rises from 0 to a higher observed count during the post-change window, ideally with app_opened_count also increasing and no deterioration in error_rate. A weaker but still supportive signal is that app_opened_count or request_count increases and at least one scan start occurs, which would directionally fit the message-clarity hypothesis.
expectedWeakeningSignal: The hypothesis is weakened if, after the full minimum observation window, app_opened_count and scan_started_count both remain at 0, or if app_opened_count rises without any scan_started_count, or if error_rate worsens enough to make engagement changes uninterpretable. That would make the specific top-message explanation less convincing and leave low traffic or downstream friction as stronger alternatives.
inconclusiveCondition: Results are inconclusive if the 30-day minimum window is not completed, if traffic remains too sparse for any meaningful before/after comparison, if other listing elements or external promotion changed during the same window, if tracking quality differs before versus after, or if no upstream exposure metric can be restored to contextualize observed counts.
